policy: Do not terminate other processes. Run one owned inference runtime at a time. Preserve whole-adapter and exact PID/LUID process counters separately. Background desktop usage remains present and is measured, not subtracted from per-process allocation or mistaken for model memory.
method: Read-only Win32_OperatingSystem, Win32_PageFileUsage, Get-Process llama-server (no command lines), and GPUAdapterMemory CIM observation.
